page.overview:
Who is Aaqlet?

Aaqlet is a character in Tears of the Kingdom.

Aaqlet is a Gerudo child who lives in Gerudo Town. She is the daughter of the Gerudo Perda and the Hylian Wabbin. The former works in the Gerudo Secret Club and the latter sits within the Gerudo shelter jail.

Link can find her looking at her secret map in the shelter's inn which shows the location of the Gerudo Secret Club. If Link has completed the side adventure "Mattison's Independence", Aaqlet and Mattison can be seen spending time together around Gerudo town during the day.
